Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
About the Company 
 At Ascom, we believe recruitment is a two-way decision.We are not only looking for someone to join us — we are looking for someone who also chooses us as their next employer.If you are looking for a role where you can make an impact, work with modern technologies, and contribute to global operations — we would love to hear from you.
 About the Role 
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our software engineering team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise-grade applications across desktop, web, and database platforms. This role requires strong expertise in Java Swing, JavaScript, PHP, HTML, CSS, and PostgreSQL, along with working knowledge of C++ and C# to support integration, maintenance, and enhancement of existing software products. The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering high-quality software solutions, contributing to system architecture decisions, mentoring junior developers, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable applications.
 Responsibilities 
 Application Development
Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications using Java 17 and Java Swing, PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and PostgreSQL.
Develop reusable components, services, and libraries.
Implement and consume RESTful APIs and integration services.
Ensure applications are secure, scalable, and performant.
 System Architecture & Design
Participate in technical design and architecture discussions.
Evaluate new technologies and propose improvements.
Define coding standards and best practices.
Contribute to modernization and migration initiatives.
 Database Management
Design and optimize PostgreSQL databases, schemas, stored procedures, and queries.
Monitor database performance and implement tuning strategies.
Ensure data integrity, security, and backup/recovery practices.
 Cross-Technology Development
Support, develop and maintain components written in C++ and C#.
Develop integration points between legacy and modern applications.
Troubleshoot issues across multiple technology stacks.
 Quality & DevOps
Write clean, maintainable, documented code.
Conduct code reviews.
Maintain automated tests.
Participate in CI/CD and deployment activities.
Resolve production and performance issues.
 Leadership & Collaboration
Mentor junior and mid-level developers.
Collaborate with Product Owners, QA, Architects, and Business Analysts.
Participate in sprint planning and technical reviews.
Act as a technical subject matter expert.
 Success Metrics
Deliver high-quality software on schedule.
Maintain low defect rates and high code quality standards.
Improve application performance, reliability, and scalability.
Contribute to architectural improvements and technical innovation.
Provide leadership and mentorship within the development team.
 Nice-to-Have Experience
Medical, telecommunications, industrial automation, or enterprise software domains.
Legacy desktop application maintenance and modernization.
Multi-tier and client-server architectures.
Cross-platform development involving Java, PHP, C++, and C# ecosystems.
 This profile would fit a senior engineer capable of owning both legacy desktop applications (Java Swing) and modern web systems (PHP/JavaScript/PostgreSQL) while supporting integrations and components developed in C++ and C#.
 Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or related field.
 Required Experience 
5+ years of professional software development experience.
Proven experience in full software development lifecycle (SDLC).
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
 Required Technical Skills

Java 17 + Java Swing
JavaScript (ES6+)
PHP
HTML5
CSS3
PostgreSQL

C++
C#
 Additional Technical Competencies

SQL query optimization

Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
Design patterns and software architecture principles
Application debugging and performance optimization
Unit and integration testing
 Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Strong ownership and accountability mindset.
Ability to mentor and lead technical discussions.
Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies.
 Preferred Skills 
Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Experience with Linux-based deployment environments.
Familiarity with Docker and containerized applications.
Understanding of CI/CD pipelines.
Experience integrating desktop and web applications.
Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
Experience working with legacy systems modernization.
